items.stem: For a busy executive deciding quickly, how should a recommendation report usually be structured?

options.text: Lead with the recommendation, then provide supporting detail
options.rationale: Correct: putting the conclusion first serves a reader who decides quickly.

options.text: Save the recommendation for the final paragraph
options.rationale: Burying the recommendation forces the reader to hunt for the point.

options.text: Omit the recommendation and present only data
options.rationale: A recommendation report should state a clear recommendation.

options.text: Use the longest possible sentences to sound thorough
options.rationale: Dense prose slows the reader; clarity and brevity serve the decision.

items.explanation: Correct: putting the conclusion first serves a reader who decides quickly.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which behaviours demonstrate active listening? (Select TWO)

options.text: Paraphrasing what you heard to confirm understanding
options.rationale: Correct: paraphrasing checks and signals understanding.

options.text: Asking a clarifying question before responding
Planning your rebuttal while the other person talks
options.rationale: Rehearsing a reply means you are not truly listening.
Interrupting disrupts the speaker and signals impatience.

items.explanation: Correct: paraphrasing checks and signals understanding.

items.stem: Why is email often a poor channel for delivering sensitive, emotionally charged news?

options.text: It strips tone and nonverbal cues, so the message is easily misread
options.rationale: Correct: without tone and body language, sensitive messages are easily misinterpreted.
Email can hold long text; the issue is missing tone and interaction.

options.text: Email is always slower than a letter
options.rationale: Speed is not the relevant drawback for sensitive news.

options.text: Sensitive topics are never appropriate to discuss
options.rationale: They can be discussed; the point is choosing a richer channel.

items.explanation: Correct: without tone and body language, sensitive messages are easily misinterpreted.
